notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Zendikar's Roil, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield as a Saproling due to Maskwood Nexus, which also causes it to be a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
